title: República Luminosa
overview: A remote island town is terrorized by 32 feral children who emerge out of the surrounding jungle. The children shatter the peace, speaking an unknown language and defying social norms, sparking widespread panic. As Daniel, the town’s official, struggles to restore order, his search for answers spirals into obsession. Tension reaches a breaking point when the children vanish, abducting the town’s youth, including Daniel’s stepdaughter.
